protocol.doc_text: '{title}\n\n{abstract}' if title else abstract; text is self-contained -- do NOT re-prepend the title column
protocol.candidate_pairs: 1-15 distinct curated PMIDs with abstracts in the records table
protocol.selection: seeded shuffle of 15919 candidates, greedily accept pairs with an unused gene and disease, no silver clash with accepted pairs, under a paced gold budget (union <= 75 * (accepted+1)/75), stop at 75
protocol.distractors: 3 hard negatives per query (225 total): abstracts linked (curated or Europe PMC) to the query gene with a disease that is not the query disease or its ancestor/descendant; 0 random curated abstracts; sampled with seed 42
protocol.silver_guard: no corpus doc is linked (curated or Europe PMC) to a query unless it is in that query's qrels
protocol.qrels: score=1 for every curated (pair, PMID) link; all gold docs are in the corpus
